races.name: Edinburgh Gin Classic Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Sonyourastar

runners_data.name: Hackley Bay
runners_data.note: Lightly raced hold-up type returning from 20 days, form hard to assess but could benefit from strong pace

runners_data.name: Way Maker
runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner with recent winning form, key pace-setter but may pay for early exertions

runners_data.name: Kibris
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning after long break, good record on similar going but fitness questionable

runners_data.name: Scriabin
runners_data.note: Consistent leader/prominent runner, will ensure strong gallop but recent form suggests vulnerability

runners_data.name: Lexington Wood
runners_data.note: Classy hold-up horse for in-form Murphy stable, ideal profile for this pace scenario

runners_data.name: L'Appel Du Large
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse but limited experience and concerning habit of fading in finishes

runners_data.name: Struth
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer wearing tongue tie and cheekpieces, needs everything to fall right

runners_data.name: Brewdog
runners_data.note: Low-rated hold-up horse who fades in finishes, hard to fancy despite tactical advantage

runners_data.name: Etretat
runners_data.note: Front-runner returning from long layoff, will ensure pace but fitness major concern

runners_data.name: Nae Bother At A'

runners_data.name: Breaking Ground

races.paceDynamic: Way Maker, Etretat, and Scriabin will clash early for the lead, creating a relentless gallop from the start. Way Maker brings recent winning form over fences and looks the most reliable pace-setter, while Etretat returns from a long break and Scriabin has been consistent in defeat recently. This strong early pace will stretch the field and test stamina over the final half-mile, setting up the race perfectly for hold-up horses with a finishing kick who can pick up the pieces late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the three confirmed leaders go too fast early and fade
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop from Way Maker, Etretat and Scriabin will empty their tanks, allowing patient hold-up horses to sweep past in the final furlong. This tactical setup strongly favours the closers with proven stamina.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Leader Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Way Maker or Scriabin can dictate without over-racing
scenarios.body: The winner will come from the early leaders who can control the tempo and have enough left for the finish. Way Maker's recent winning form over fences gives him the edge if he can rate kindly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Kibris or another prominent runner gets the perfect trip
scenarios.body: A horse tracking the leaders closely will have the ideal position to strike when the pace collapses but before the hold-up horses arrive. This requires precise timing and a good jumping round.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Maiden Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is unsustainable and form horses disappoint
scenarios.body: One of the less exposed runners like Hackley Bay or Breaking Ground could benefit from a truly-run race where class matters less than stamina and jumping. Long odds but possible in a maiden.

watchPoints.text: Way Maker and Scriabin will clash for the early lead - if they go too fast both could fade dramatically
Kibris returns after 108 days off which raises serious fitness concerns despite his prominent running style
Etretat makes his hurdles debut after flat racing - watch his jumping and how he handles the pace
Several runners including Hackley Bay and Brewdog have shown concerning tendencies to fade in the finish
The Murphy-trained pair Sonyourastar and Lexington Wood could benefit most if the strong pace materializes

races.name: DM Hall Surveyors Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Busty Boy
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist who needs a strong pace to be effective but has been consistently placed recently and handles these conditions well.

runners_data.name: Largy Force
runners_data.note: Class horse with excellent soft ground record (13/14) whose hold-up style could be compromised by the likely lack of early pace but has winning form over similar trips.

runners_data.name: Red Happy
runners_data.note: Front-runner in excellent form with three recent wins who should dictate terms but carries top weight and hasn't been tested beyond 2m4f recently.

runners_data.name: Ned Tanner
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with useful course experience whose trainer is in good form but hasn't won for over a year despite consistent placing.

runners_data.name: Inis Oirr
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who won last time but faces a significant step up in class and relies on apprentice Walkingshaw's 10lb claim.

runners_data.name: Cosmic Blizzard
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from a 72-day break who has never won over fences but showed promise in novice company last season.

races.paceDynamic: Red Happy will take this race by the scruff of the neck from the start, with his prominent style and recent front-running wins suggesting he'll dictate terms. Ned Tanner and Cosmic Blizzard may try to sit handy, but with three hold-up horses (Busty Boy, Largy Force, Inis Oirr) needing the pace to develop, Red Happy faces minimal early pressure. The 3-mile trip on soft ground should see Red Happy stretch the field through the middle stages, creating a searching gallop that will test stamina reserves. This race shape strongly favours the front-runner and any horse that can travel prominently, as the hold-up brigade face a significant disadvantage with limited pace pressure early.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Red Happy Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Red Happy jumps well and faces no early pressure from the prominent runners
scenarios.body: Red Happy gets an uncontested lead and builds an insurmountable advantage through the testing middle stages. The hold-up horses are left with too much to do when the real racing begins.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Duel Develops
scenarios.trigger: If Ned Tanner or Cosmic Blizzard press Red Happy from an early stage
scenarios.body: A genuine pace battle emerges that sets the race up perfectly for the stronger staying hold-up horses. Largy Force's superior class and Busty Boy's consistency become decisive factors.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Steady Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Red Happy goes too slow early trying to conserve energy for the finish
scenarios.body: The lack of genuine pace allows the hold-up horses to get into contention without expending energy. Largy Force's proven soft ground form and recent wins give him the edge in a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Red Happy Stops Late
scenarios.trigger: If Red Happy's recent busy schedule or the testing conditions catch up with him in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The front-runner's tanks empty just when the closers hit top gear, creating a dramatic late reversal. Busty Boy's hold-up style and solid recent form make him the primary beneficiary.

watchPoints.text: Red Happy's jumping under pressure - any early mistakes could derail his front-running tactics completely.
Largy Force's position turning in - if he's further back than usual, the lack of pace will have compromised his chance.
Cosmic Blizzard's fitness after 72 days off - any signs of blowing early will confirm the layoff has dulled his edge.
Ned Tanner's enthusiasm early - if he's unusually keen, it could provide the pace pressure needed to set up the race.
Busty Boy's position at halfway - needs to be within striking distance despite his hold-up style given the likely lack of pace.

races.name: Edinburgh Gin Hugo Spritz Handicap Hurdle (Div I)

runners_data.name: Bold Light
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with strong recent form, Alan Doyle a 3lb claimer but Lucinda Russell stable in good heart

runners_data.name: Summergrounds
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up performer with excellent soft ground record, Nicky Richards 3/6 strike rate suggests readiness

runners_data.name: Carismatic Soldier
runners_data.note: Only winner was on heavy ground over 2m, struggled in better company but fair mark now for Olly Murphy
runners_data.comment: Only win was over 2m on heavy; not at his best last 4 starts; looks stable second string
runners_data.spotlight: Only win was in a Chepstow novice on heavy in January 2025 (2m); not at his best last four starts but on a fair mark now; looks stable second string.

runners_data.name: Sun Art
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who won in tongue-tie at Ludlow, consistent placer but limited winning experience
runners_data.comment: Won in first-time tongue-tie at Ludlow (2m) in March 2025; runner-up latest; stamina 2m4f?
runners_data.spotlight: Won in first-time tongue-tie at Ludlow (2m, novice; good) in March 2025; placed in three of his five starts since, runner-up to the 13-8 favourite Wild Goose at Hereford (2m, good) four weeks ago; stamina not yet proven over 2m4f; possible.

runners_data.name: Moyganny Phil
runners_data.note: Lightly raced hold-up type, won last time on soft but 40 days off may need this run

runners_data.name: Dalileo
runners_data.note: Veteran hold-up horse returning after lay-off, won over 3m here last July but hasn't run since November
runners_data.comment: 4-56, latest win over 3m here last July on 2nd run after a break; may come on for the run
runners_data.spotlight: Record of 4-56, latest win coming off this mark over 3m here last July (good) on second run after a break; hasn't been out since November; should come on for the run.

runners_data.name: Easy To Follow
runners_data.note: Prominent runner back after 112-day break, good soft ground record but freshness a concern

runners_data.name: Follow Charlie
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with poor trainer form, wears first-time cheekpieces but stable 0/8 recently

runners_data.name: Dubhain
runners_data.note: Only front-runner in field, wears hood and tongue-tie, inconsistent but should get easy lead here

races.paceDynamic: Dubhain is the sole confirmed front-runner and will get an uncontested lead in this weak pace scenario, setting a steady tempo over the extended 2m4f trip on testing ground. Easy To Follow may sit prominent but is returning from 112 days off, leaving Dubhain largely unopposed through the early stages. The large field of hold-up horses including Bold Light, Summergrounds, and Carismatic Soldier will be bunched behind, creating a tactical crawl before a frantic finish. This race shape clearly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can steal a decisive advantage before the wall of closers can mount their challenge.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Dubhain Steals Easy Lead
scenarios.trigger: If Dubhain gets the expected soft lead without pressure from Easy To Follow early
scenarios.body: The pace becomes dangerously slow, allowing the leader to dictate completely and kick clear when the closers are still getting organized. Hold-up horses face an impossible task from too far back on the testing ground.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Closers Time It Right
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and the field comes home in a bunch
scenarios.body: The superior class of Bold Light and Summergrounds tells in a cavalry charge finish, with their proven form at this level showing. Multiple horses hit the line together with the best horses prevailing.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Murphy Stable Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Carismatic Soldier and Easy To Follow both run to their best for in-form Olly Murphy
scenarios.body: The stable's tactical awareness sees Easy To Follow press early while Carismatic Soldier is delivered late, creating a one-two punch. Murphy's strong 4/16 record suggests both runners are primed.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses challenge Dubhain early and the pace becomes truly run throughout
scenarios.body: The genuine gallop sets up perfectly for the strongest stayers, with horses coming from impossible positions. The race becomes a test of stamina rather than tactics.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Easy To Follow shows any early keenness after the long break - could ruin Dubhain's easy lead scenario
Watch Bold Light's jumping rhythm early - needs to travel smoothly to deliver his trademark late kick
Watch Sean Bowen's positioning on Moyganny Phil - top jockey may have been given confident instructions
Watch the pace through the first mile - if genuinely steady, the front two may prove impossible to catch
Watch Carismatic Soldier's settles pattern - needs to drop out completely to reproduce his Chepstow win

runners_data.name: Kinbara Firstdraft

runners_data.name: Sauce Of Life

runners_data.name: Atlantic City

runners_data.name: Wasdell Dundalk
runners_data.note: Hold-up veteran returning after 232 days with solid course record but major fitness questions.

runners_data.name: Largy Meadow

runners_data.name: Getaway Master
runners_data.note: Patient tactical type who ran yesterday which raises immediate fitness and recovery concerns.
runners_data.comment: Modest recent efforts at Chepstow and Hexham; fair mark but best form is on soft/heavy.
runners_data.spotlight: No reason to recommend on strength of modest efforts this year at Chepstow and Hexham (twice); however, the handicapper has cut him some slack, and he sits just 1lb higher than when winning readily at Carlisle (2m4f, soft) last November; best form is on soft/heavy.

races.paceDynamic: Lets Mingle represents the sole confirmed front-runner in this field and should get an uncontested lead early on. With most runners adopting prominent or hold-up tactics, there's insufficient early pressure to create a truly searching gallop over this stamina-testing 2m4f trip on soft ground. The lack of pace pressure means Lets Mingle can dictate terms from the front, while the prominent runners like Atlantic City, Kado Sacree and Annie Agnew will need to commit earlier than ideal to stay competitive. This tactical setup clearly favours front-runners and early prominent types who can secure good positions without expending excessive energy.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Lets Mingle Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Lets Mingle gets away with soft fractions through the early stages
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows the leader to store energy for a sustained kick, making it extremely difficult for hold-up horses to close the gap on testing ground. Prominent runners who track closely benefit from the steady tempo but may lack the tactical advantage of the front-runner.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle Develops
scenarios.trigger: If Atlantic City and Kado Sacree press Lets Mingle from the early stages
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and brings stamina into play, suiting those with proven staying power over the trip. Hold-up horses face an impossible task as the pace quickens beyond the ideal closing sectional.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Closing
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace completely collapses and becomes pedestrian throughout
scenarios.body: The lack of any meaningful gallop allows patient riders to deliver late challenges, though they still face the disadvantage of covering extra ground. Proven stayers with tactical speed can capitalise on a sprint finish scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Collapse After Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If early pace pressure causes the leaders to capitulate dramatically
scenarios.body: Those who avoided the early battle can pick up the pieces, but this requires a significant collapse from well-handicapped front-runners. The soft ground makes recovery from early exertion extremely difficult.

watchPoints.text: Getaway Master ran just yesterday which presents serious recovery concerns for this stamina test
Watch Lets Mingle's early fractions as uncontested lead could prove decisive on this demanding ground
Atlantic City's conditional jockey James King claiming 3lb provides significant weight advantage in tight handicap
Sauce Of Life and Wasdell Dundalk both return from 200+ day breaks raising obvious fitness questions
Monitor early positions of Kinbara Firstdraft and other hold-up horses as they face clear tactical disadvantage

races.name: Edinburgh Gin Seaside Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Double Oban
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits this pace setup perfectly with Olly Murphy's 3/15 record providing confidence in placement

runners_data.name: Just Dottie
runners_data.note: Hold-up style needs strong early pace to be effective, but recent Wetherby second shows retained ability

runners_data.name: Pure Gold
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner faces tactical challenge but Lisa Harrison stable in good form despite 0/1 record

runners_data.name: Oh Janey
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 195-day break but Crawford horses often need time to find full fitness

runners_data.name: Magnolia
runners_data.note: Hold-up style disadvantaged by likely pace scenario, though headgear changes suggest connections seeking improvement

runners_data.name: Trust House
runners_data.note: Natural front runner with Sean Bowen's big-race experience, recent Chepstow win shows good current form

runners_data.name: Castle Ivers
runners_data.note: Fellow leader whose hurdles debut win suggests talent, but 27 days since last run might leave him vulnerable to fitter rivals
runners_data.comment: Useful bumper & maiden hurdle winner; tailed off on recent comeback run (h'cap debut).
runners_data.spotlight: Looked useful when winning a Wetherby bumper by 7l in March 2024; hurdles career off to a perfect start at Warwick (2m, good to soft) the following season, but absent for 18-plus months thereafter until reappearing at Ayr (4-1 favourite; tailed off) recently; now sits 2lb lower.

races.paceDynamic: Castle Ivers and Trust House will contest the early lead, with both Murphy-trained front runners having shown ability to dictate terms at this trip. Double Oban and Oh Janey should sit prominent behind the leaders, while the hold-up quartet of Just Dottie, Pure Gold, and Magnolia will need the pace to be strong enough to set up their late charges. With two confirmed pace-setters ensuring an honest gallop over 2 miles on soft ground, this race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the pace and strike turning for home rather than out-and-out hold-up horses who may find themselves too far back.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Murphy Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Trust House or Castle Ivers gets an uncontested lead and controls the fractions
scenarios.body: The leader will dictate comfortable splits and prove too strong in the finish, with soft ground suiting their stamina profiles. The prominent trackers will pick up the pieces but struggle to reel in the pacesetter.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the two leaders go too hard early and compromise each other
scenarios.body: Double Oban or Oh Janey will benefit from tracking the pace battle and have enough left to strike decisively in the straight. The early leaders will weaken from their exertions allowing the prominent runners to take over.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely strong and the leaders come back dramatically
scenarios.body: Just Dottie or Magnolia will benefit from a truly-run race that sets up perfectly for their closing kicks. The soft ground will aid their stamina reserves over the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go too slow and it becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical affair where Pure Gold's class could shine in a messy finish. Any horse with a turn of foot will have chances in a bunched field.

watchPoints.text: Trust House and Castle Ivers both want to lead - if they engage in early speed duel it could compromise both Murphy runners
Oh Janey returning from 195-day layoff against race-fit opponents, market support will indicate readiness
Just Dottie needs strong early pace from the leaders to set up her hold-up style effectively
Pure Gold's low TopSpeed figure of 102 suggests she may lack the finishing kick needed in tactical finish
Double Oban ideally placed to benefit if the two leaders clash, with prominent style suiting race shape perfectly

races.name: Edinburgh Cannonball Handicap Chase

runners_data.name: Carrigeen Castle
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist with strong similar-going record (15 runs, 3 wins, 7 places) but 50 days off and jumping fluency remains a concern despite decent recent form

runners_data.name: Traveling Soldier
runners_data.note: Only prominent runner giving him perfect tactical position, returns from 192-day break but Sean Bowen's 10lb claim and strong recent hurdles form suggest readiness

runners_data.name: Sir Carnegie
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up performer who completed double at Kelso in cheekpieces, just 1 day since last run but jumping fluency issues remain a tactical liability
runners_data.comment: Back to form when chasing home Inis Oirr over C&D (good) three weeks ago; sits 2lb higher.
runners_data.spotlight: Completed a double with win at Kelso (3m, good to soft; 11-4) last November; wasn't fluent - has been a theme - but bounced back to form in reapplied cheekpieces when chasing home Inis Oirr over C&D (good) three weeks ago; 2lb higher with James Bowen taking over in the saddle; likely candidate.

runners_data.name: Wings On Wheels
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with poorest recent form but proven headgear in place, needs career-best effort off 64-day break to feature prominently here

runners_data.name: Tanking Along
runners_data.note: Lone front-runner with tactical advantage, 8 days since decent Goodwood second suggests current form, but Charlie Maggs' 3lb claim adds pressure in key role

runners_data.name: Uncle Al
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with cheekpieces retained from December win but three poor efforts since and Jessica Bedi's 0/8 trainer record over 14 days raises reliability concerns
runners_data.comment: Won at Sedgefield in December but hasn't performed to the same level subsequently
runners_data.spotlight: Won off this mark in first-time cheekpieces (retained since) at Sedgefield in December but below par on his next three starts and he unseated early at Hexham 12 days ago; needs to get back on track.

races.paceDynamic: Tanking Along stands alone as the confirmed front-runner and will control the tempo from the start without early pressure. With five hold-up horses (Carrigeen Castle, Sir Carnegie, Wings On Wheels, Uncle Al) and just one prominent runner (Traveling Soldier), this creates a tactical speed duel waiting to happen in the final half-mile. The steady early gallop will suit the patient types, but when Traveling Soldier and the hold-up brigade make their moves, it becomes a question of who has the most tactical speed. This race shape strongly favours horses with proven finishing kick from off the pace, as they'll have every chance to time their challenge perfectly against an uncontested leader.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Brigade Pounces
scenarios.trigger: If the patient runners time their challenges perfectly against the uncontested leader
scenarios.body: The steady early pace sets up perfectly for the closers, with Tanking Along becoming a sitting duck when the cavalry charges. Sir Carnegie and Carrigeen Castle, both proven over similar trips, benefit most from this tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Traveling Soldier Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the sole prominent runner bridges the gap effectively between leader and pack
scenarios.body: Traveling Soldier uses his tactical position to track Tanking Along before pouncing, avoiding the late traffic that could hinder the hold-up horses. His recent good form and Sean Bowen's tactical nous prove decisive in this intermediate position.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Tanking Along's recent Goodwood second translates to strong current form and the chasers leave it too late
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader builds an unassailable advantage as the hold-up horses fail to coordinate their challenges effectively. Charlie Maggs keeps things simple from the front while the others get in each other's way.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Tanking Along goes too slow and gets swamped by multiple challengers turning for home
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace creates a cavalry charge finish where the best jumper and strongest stayer prevails. This messy scenario could suit an outsider who avoids the inevitable trouble in running.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Tanking Along goes too fast early - could collapse and create messy finish favouring hold-up horses with tactical speed
Watch Traveling Soldier's jumping after 192 days off - any early mistakes will destroy his perfect tactical position between leader and pack
Watch Sir Carnegie's fluency at the fences - has winning form but jumping errors could cost him when challenges develop
Watch for traffic problems in the straight with five hold-up horses converging - could favour Traveling Soldier's tracking position
Watch Uncle Al's early enthusiasm - longest price but cheekpieces work and recent poor form might have lowered expectations artificially
